person.label: Person
person.description: Compact person card for staff directories and team grids. Three display formats: block (default), list (horizontal), tabular (table row).

slots.name: name
slots.description:
Full name. Accepts a plain

or an linking to a profile page; both render IDENTICALLY (.person-name.umd-sans-larger, black, 700 weight, no underline, no hover state), so a grid where only some cards link gives the reader no way to tell which are actionable. Either link every card or add your own affordance.

attrs.name: data-display
attrs.description: Layout. Omit for default block layout.

variants.list: Horizontal row with image on one side.

person.notes: Email and phone slots accept anchor tags for proper mailto:/tel: links. For grid layouts, use umd-layout-grid-border-four/three/two (see LAYOUT-PATTERNS.md) with class='umd-shell-person-grid-helper' on every host element — this class is required for responsive cell padding via container queries. This component re-renders ADDITIVELY when it reconnects: taking a card out of the DOM and putting it back appends a second .person-block to its shadow root, so the card draws the same person twice at double height. Build dynamic lists from data and append on paging - never move an existing card. See OVERRIDES.md "Dynamic person lists".

person-bio.label: Person Bio
person-bio.description: Full biographical profile with description paragraph(s). Use for faculty profile pages or featured staff bios.

attrs.name: data-image
attrs.description: Use full-size image layout. Omit for small image (default).

variants.small: Small portrait image alongside bio text (default).
variants.full: Large prominent image for featured bios.

person-hero.label: Person Hero
person-hero.description: Hero-scale individual feature for a person profile landing page. Includes a breadcrumb slot so it can replace the standard breadcrumb on the page.

slots.name: association
slots.description: Department or unit. NOT RENDERED by this component (verified against the shadow tree in cdn.js@1.18.12): person-hero rebuilds its text lockup from the light DOM reading only `name` and `job-title`, so anything in this slot is dead markup. The slot does work on umd-element-person and umd-element-person-bio.

slots.name: breadcrumb
slots.description: Breadcrumb nav. Takes a umd-element-breadcrumb and nothing else - the component validates this slot and logs 'Slot "breadcrumb" contains invalid elements' for any other content, which then renders as unstyled light-DOM links. The component manages the desktop/mobile variants internally by cloning your element into a second `breadcrumb-copy` slot; that clone comes FIRST in document order, so querySelector('umd-element-breadcrumb') returns the mobile one (display:none and 0x0 at desktop) - select on [slot="breadcrumb"] instead.

person-hero.notes: Put umd-element-breadcrumb IN the breadcrumb slot rather than rendering a standalone one elsewhere on the page. Only `name` and `job-title` reach the text lockup - `association` is accepted but never rendered. This component clones the light DOM into its shadow root rather than projecting it through <slot>, so page CSS cannot reach the name, job title, email or actions; anything cosmetic there needs a shadow injection. `breadcrumb` is the one exception - it is a real <slot>, so its content stays in the light DOM and page CSS does apply.
